data.long_meaning: Ompal is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Omkara', which represents the sound of the universe. The name Ompal is believed to signify the supreme lord who pervades and governs the entire cosmos. The name Ompal carries the meaning “Lord of the Universe” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ompal usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the universe and live with faith, good character and purpose.
